Sofia: Policy: credits > $500 need controller sign-off. Tagging @Mark.

Ben: Hold 60m for customer comms and Sales review.

```
billing-cli invoices reconcile --invoice INV-9750 --dry-run
billing-cli credits create --invoice INV-9750 --amount 700 --reason "grandfathering backfill" --dry-run
billing-cli prices upload --manifest gs://redwood-prod/manifests/ab-rollout-fixed.csv --dry-run
```
BillingBot: INV-9750 generated 2026-05-02 10:20 UTC. Status: paid. Dry-run does not change ledger.
